description: Gate between the EISA assessor and the write step: every row to assess needs an allowed Implemented value, every claim a short rationale, evidence and a section in the proof document. Blocking findings go back to the assessor as feedback.

params.label: Rationale length
params.description: Characters above which a rationale is flagged as too long (minor).

params.label: Require a proof section
params.description: Every Y / N / Partial answer must have a section in the proof document (when the proof port is wired).

portSummary: Reads rows, assessment, proof; produces report, feedback.
